title: SmimeError missing Clone — asymmetric with VerificationResult (Clone+Eq)
description: error.rs: SmimeError derives only Debug, and has Display+Error impls. VerificationResult and SignerResult derive Clone+PartialEq+Eq. Callers who wrap SmimeError in their own error type cannot derive Clone if they store SmimeError. AllSignersFailed(Vec<SignerResult>) contains Clone data but the parent enum is not Clone. Fix: derive Clone on SmimeError (the Der variant contains der::Error; check if that's Clone — if not, manual impl or remove the constraint).
